title: FREE REQUEST Athendom Will Fall-Crowmurder is Looking for New Team Members!!

posts.author: Licco
posts.body:
ATHENDOM NEEDS YOUR HELP!!!
​
Introduction​
Hey there, I’m Licco! Lead Developer of Athendom Will Fall and Head of Crowmurder Team.
And I’m here to ask you all if you’d be willing to offer a few helping [detachable] hands! I’m currently looking for long/short term members for my dev-team to work on my game with me in the RPG Maker MV Engine.
What’s The Game?​
Athendom Will Fall is an episodic, story heavy Mother 2&3 and Deltarune inspired JRPG game that takes place inside the operating system of a breaking computer.
Athen OS is home to countless sentient computer programs and files that all live in their own eco-system.
But their world is facing its impending doom when “THE OVERWRITE” looms upon this computer. A force which exists solely to wipe the inhabitants of Athen OS.
Only one chosen program is able to stop this apocalyptic event from occurring. They must travel from numerous internet realms and gather the 8 Deactivation keys to save their world
[Read A LOT more
here
]
What am
I
gonna be doing?​
As I said earlier, I’m licco. A sprite artist, script writer, geek and pretty sprite animator. I've worked with other teams on a little art touch-up here and there [I doubt I'm contractually allowed to mention which ones :/ ] You’d be forgiven for not knowing me, but I’m a big deal in the artist community. They just don’t know it either yet. [check out my sprite art in the devlogs of Athendom Will Fall on
itch.io
]
I’m gonna be working on most of the SUPER BIG-KID art, and more or less all the writing, dialog or otherwise.
I’m not just the “idea-man” that I see everyone hating on around here.
I for one would love to meet him, I’m sure he’s a nice guy if you get to know him. I just wouldn’t let him anywhere near my baby [Athendom Will Fall] as he has a very poor work ethic, Unlike me :]
.
I’ve also been told I’m a really nice person over all by my millions and billions of friends, so I don’t bite, we’re not there yet!
Where can You help?​
Currently I’m looking for a... well the basic minimum for a gamedev team that can help increase productivity in all fields so going that my list that’ll be:
A programmer
. (JavaScript or has worked with RPGMaker)
A sprite artist
for NPCs, dialog sprite art, UI art and items. (Capable of matching the main theme of the games mother-like art)
A tile artist.
(Capable of matching the main theme of the games mother-like art)
A music composer.
(Capable of going with both energetic and somber music; bonus if they can also work on 8-bit tracks that are reminiscent of the old SNes era
A sound designer
that can work with cartoony sound effects to fit the theme of the game.
Don't think "I'd love to help but my art sucks :[", you don't need to be a Picasso, everybody has their strong suit. and for a game as chaotic as Athendom Will Fall, there's EVENTUALLY gotta be a place for your work as long as you can work with a team :]
What’s in it for You?​
As of right now... because the project is still at its beginning phase, I intend to utilize all the help I can get from you all to make a feasible, functional demo [Episode one] that’s fully playable and sharable, when that’s done I intend to start a crowdfunding campaign [like Kickstarter] or an indie sponsorship application [like outersloth] which I will then use to hire full-time members for Crowmurder or if you’re still interested in working with me against all odds and can make history TOGETHER!!!
[I'll Explain more in the volunteer channel on the Athendom discord :] ]
So, what do you say pal? Wanna have a hand in this?
If no: I still love you, just a lil less :[
If
“HELL YEAH!! WHERE DO I SIGN UP!?”
Then feel free to shoot me a DM on discord: licco._ [just my name with “._”] with some of your work where I’ll give you a thumbs up or a thumbs up because I don’t know how to say no to people, as I get very nervous.
When I see your DM request ill add you to the official Crowmurder Discord server with other fans of Athendom Will Fall with the “Volunteer” Role, giving you special pings with work I need help with in a certain field.
Closing​
If you made it this far, I think I’ve managed to give you a clear enough idea of what I’m offering and what you can offer for this project. I’ll await your DM applications soon!
See you soon, Licco.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Licco said:
Thing is: I actually deal with premature presbyopia which basically gives me unbelievable trouble reading and writing lines of code and focusing on numbers.
Click to expand...
So you absolutely know your body better than I do, and what your specific circumstances are, and all that.
But since you're putting it here as a public reason for needing someone else to do some tasks - between text editors where you can zoom in, scaling up Windows as a whole, or using the magnifying tool built into it, this just sounds odd.
I don't understand the situation wherein you can read and type in the forum text boxes (and your opening post is probably the best I've seen in recruitment!) but can't type stuff to paste into note fields in the editor. Unless, of course, you're actually doing all of this via screen reader and dictation.
That completely aside:
Licco said:
I couldn't figure out how to get a party member to take damage DURING the animations of the codekill attacks(I intended them to receive damage in real time as they receive damage in the animation
Click to expand...
Aqua is correct, this is done pretty easily using action sequences.
You'd start the animation then count out when to do the hits
action animation
wait
action effect
wait
action effect
with whatever the correct number of frames to wait should be. You should also be able find examples of sequences like that in the various action sequence threads (or you can try to make it and then ask for help without having to hire someone).
Or I believe there are people who are not coders,
per se
, but will do action sequences by commission. If that's the extent of the kinds of work you want done, you may have a hard time attracting an actual, knowledgeable coder for that role.
Good luck with your project!
